title: Do DeepONet Trunk-Basis Preconditioners Need Training?
abstract: arXiv:2611.27582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Trunk-basis (TB) preconditioners build the coarse space of a two-level Schwarz preconditioner from the trunk functions of a trained deep operator network (DeepONet), restricted to subdomains. Their effectiveness has been attributed to spectral bias since networks learn low frequencies first, complementing a smoother that removes the high-frequency error. Spectral bias, however, is a property of training, whereas a randomly initialized trunk with a smooth activation is already smooth. We therefore ask whether TB preconditioners need training. In one dimension, we prove that on each subdomain the span of untrained trunk functions is close to the space of low-degree polynomials under suitable nondegeneracy assumptions. Numerically, for the Poisson equation and three-dimensional linear elasticity with constant coefficients, untrained TB and piecewise polynomial coarse spaces of equal dimension yield close conjugate gradient iteration count

translated_title: DeepONet主干基预条件子需要训练吗？
translated_abstract: 主干基（TB）预条件子利用训练好的深度算子网络的分支函数构建双层Schwarz预条件子的粗空间。其有效性一直被归因于频谱偏差，即网络首先学习低频成分，从而与消除高频误差的平滑器形成互补。然而，频谱偏差是训练过程的一种特性，而带有光滑激活函数的随机初始化分支本身就已经是光滑的。因此我们提出疑问：TB预条件子是否真的需要训练？在一维情形下，我们证明了在适当的非退化假设下，每个子域上未训练分支函数的张成空间接近于低次多项式空间。数值实验表明，对于泊松方程和常系数三维线弹性问题，相同维度的未训练TB粗空间与分段多项式粗空间产生相近的共轭梯度迭代次数。
tldr: 该研究表明DeepONet主干基预条件子无需训练——未训练的随机初始化分支函数张成的空间近似低次多项式空间，其预条件效果与训练后的版本相当。
en_tdlr: This study shows that DeepONet trunk-basis preconditioners do not require training—untrained randomly initialized trunk functions span a space close to that of low-degree polynomials, achieving preconditioning performance comparable to trained versions.
